549-4050-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-4050-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.
549-4050-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat

2921-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-6854--5--195.description:

When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.

The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
